body: Hello, we have measured the FP8 GEMM performance using Triton on NVIDIA H100 (500 W, 1980 MHz). We would like to request your help in understanding if the performance is expected. Since H100 FP8 only supports NT GEMM (matrix B is transposed), so we tested the performance with matrix B transposed and not transposed. We also tested with `fp8_fast_accum=True` and `fp8_fast_accum=False`. Results overview: - Comparing to the CUBLAS performance, the performance of Triton GEMM is ~15% lower than the CUBLAS GEMM performance - `fp8_fast_accum = True` has a significant positive impact on the performance. ![triton_vs_cublas_fp8_h1002](https://github.com/openai/triton/assets/17482891/f567e9ba-1ee0-4120-8251-3a1094264b68) Our benchmark: [fp8_matmul.py.zip](https://github.com/openai/triton/files/13034506/fp8_matmul.py.zip) Questions: - Are the performance numbers expected? - What does `fp8_fast_accum=True` do? Does it set `CUBLASLT_MATMUL_DESC_FAST_ACCUM=1` and/or do something differently? Thank you very much!
title: Understanding Triton GEMM FP8 performance
